title: Adore Plus Dry Iron
subtitle: 1100 W Black
key_features: Double Coated for consistent heat flow for superior irnong. Upper Coat safegaurds the upper fabric layer from damage and inner coat to improve heat distribution
Shock-Proof Plastic Body for Safety- Durable, insulated body ensures protection from electric shocks — safe for everyday home use.
Built for Comfort — Lightweight body combined with a streamlined handle ensures effortless handling.
2-Years Doorstep Warranty: Ensuring peace of mind and long-lasting performance.

Powerful 1100 W Performance: The 1100 W power output ensures fast heat-up and stable temperature maintenance. This results in uniform heat distribution across the ironing surface, even during continuous use.

Silver Coated Thermostatic Copper connector bulbs: Silver coating enhances the copper connecter life and maintain higher conductivity levels over the usage years, than copper. Temperature sensing and control is also more accurate and precise.

Havells Dry Irons comes with both Safety as well as Performance ISI certifications: The Safety ISI certification validates protection against electrical hazards, overheating, and insulation failure, while the Performance ISI certification assures consistent heating efficiency, power output accuracy, and reliable operation over time. Consumers get complete peace of mind—a dry iron that is safe to use every day and delivers dependable ironing performance, backed by trusted government‑mandated quality standards.

German Coating Greblon – Non-Stick coated sole plate for smooth gliding & long life: The Greblon non‑stick coating reduces friction, allowing the iron to glide effortlessly over all fabric types without snagging or sticking. Its high resistance to wear, scratches, and stains ensures the soleplate remains smooth and efficient even after prolonged, regular use. Consumers experience effortless ironing with fewer strokes, reduced fabric drag, and consistently uniform results, along with a long‑life soleplate that continues to perform like new over time.
Aerodynamic Design with shock proof front: Convenience & Shock proof plastic body ensures safe ironing experience.
